introduction: Arkansas Weatherization Assistance improves eligible homes through energy-efficiency and health-and-safety measures. Local service providers handle applications and arrange the work identified by an energy audit.

who: Households within the state’s current income rules may qualify. The state overview uses 200% of federal poverty guidelines.
Households with an SSI recipient or receiving or eligible for LIHEAP have categorical eligibility described by the state. The home and other program conditions still need review.
sections.get: The provider uses diagnostic assessment to determine approved conservation work. No client contribution is required. The program is not a cash allowance to spend on independently selected renovations.
sections.docs: The state requests household income and identifying records and the previous 12 months of utility bills. Ask the provider for the exact checklist and any ownership or landlord-permission records needed before an assessment.
sections.apply:
1. Open the state WAP page and its local-provider link.
  2. Apply to the community action agency or nonprofit serving the county where the home is located.
  3. Supply the requested records and arrange assessment access if selected. Discuss permissions before any work is scheduled.
sections.after: Ask about waiting time, the audit and the approved measures. Keep the completion record. Do not pay a private contractor expecting later reimbursement through this program.
sections.sources:
• Arkansas WAP eligibility, documents and intake
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Is LIHEAP approval mandatory for everyone?
The state describes income eligibility as well as categorical routes through SSI or LIHEAP. Ask the provider which pathway fits your household.
The service provider uses an energy audit and approved conservation measures.
Do I pay a client contribution?
The state overview says no client contribution is required.
The local community action agency or nonprofit serving the home’s county.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
